correctness.rationale: With c cyclic vertices fixed and m=n−c>0, deleting the root rows/columns from the outgoing forest Laplacian with s forbidden targets gives (n−s)I−1aᵀ with aᵀ1=m−s. Its determinant is c(n−s)^(m−1), so the ratio to c n^(m−1) supplies exactly the subset-avoidance probabilities; inclusion–exclusion supplies the full indicator law. For c=n all vertices are hit. The successive mean difference also works at c=n−1. Conditional on a fixed vertex being unhit, the uniform mapping on the complement has the same cyclic count as the full mapping, yielding the exact covariance. Telescoping gives h_n(c)−E R_n=−q^(n−1)+∑_{j<c}(j/n)q^(n−j−2), uniformly giving the claimed limit for admissible c_n=O(√n). The bound 1+c²/(2n) also holds at c=n: the last summand exceeds its j/n bound by exactly 1/n, covered by the slack. The exact cyclic tail is (n)_c/n^c, giving Rayleigh moment convergence by the birthday bound. Thus the covariance coefficient is e^(−1)Cov(X,X²)/2=e^(−1)√(π/8), and Var(R_n)/n=q^n(1−q^n)+(n−1)[(1−2/n)^n−q^(2n)] tends to e^(−1)−2e^(−2). The stated correlation follows. The frozen exact and numerical test code was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The conditional limit's sequence is understood to take values in the support 1≤c_n≤n; outside it the displayed conditional expectation is undefined. The Finding could say this explicitly.
